title: Stale SCHC '18-33 bytes' figures in README.md:52 and AGENTS.md:123 vs normative 23/37
description: Found during 3x codereview of b7z9.205. README.md:52 says 'SCHC compresses baseline IPv6+UDP headers to 18-33 bytes' and AGENTS.md:123 says 'Baseline IPv6/UDP headers compress from 48 bytes to 18-33 bytes'. Both contradict the normative spec/03-adaptation.md 5.3 figures (Rule 0 link-local IPv6+UDP+CoAP = 23 bytes, Rule 1 Yggdrasil = 37 bytes; uncompressed base 52 bytes, not 48). Project docs, not normative spec, so P3. Fix: update both to 23/37 with Yggdrasil terminology. Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.205.
close_reason: Corrected README.md:52 and AGENTS.md:123 stale SCHC figures to normative 23/37-byte Rule 0/Rule 1 with 52-byte uncompressed base (was 18-33/48), terminology matching landed spec wording. Landed in commit 31a581c4aa (bd auto-sync swept the 2-line docs diff; contains exactly the two intended hunks). 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS, security PASS, edge-cases PASS-with-findings -> two residual defects filed as new P3 schc beads: 7gfj (README.md:147-148 '60+/41 bytes/native-address') and r7xp (AGENTS.md Open Questions item 1 vs settled pre-provisioned decision). Implementers of 7gfj/r7xp: rebase on origin/main first; appendix-misc.md already fixed there via b7z9.205.
